question: Who was Guy's Rival?
semantic_status: Hybrid mode ready: semantic model remains in this browser session.
answer: [1] All declared their support for Richard provided that he support Guy against his rival Conrad of Montferrat.

sources.excerpt:
# Normans

## Context 1
Various princes of the Holy Land arrived in Limassol at the same time, in particular Guy de Lusignan. All declared their support for Richard provided that he support Guy against his rival Conrad of Montferrat. The local barons abandoned Isaac, who considered making peace with Richard, joining him on the crusade, and offering his daughter in marriage to the person named by Richard. But Isaac changed his mind and tried to escape. Richard then proceeded to conquer the whole island, his troops being led by Guy de Lusignan. Isaac surrendered and was confined with silver chains, because Richard had promised that he would not place him in irons. By 1 June, Richard had conquered the whole island.
